_comment: Doors that never open, and what live answers to their Open (rsprox captures cited per entry). box: the line comes in a message box (messagebox 229) rather than the chat; npc: the line is that NPC's chathead line (chat_left 231) with head animation expression; delay: ticks after the click is answered before the line comes (the player has turned to the door by then); sound: the synth played with it. The Doors plugin otherwise opens prisonbarsdoor_locked and frisb_abode_door_locked onto their cache open leaves (closed id + 1, Close).
